display_taper.note: Per-vertex display weight: 0 on the ROI boundary, smoothstep of the graph geodesic distance up to 1 at the local band width from it, on the frozen template correspondence. The band is band_units near the landmarks and widens (smoothstep of the landmark geodesic distance over [widen_start, widen_start+widen_span]) to band_units_wide in rim regions far from every landmark, so the lateral cheek-side band next to the alae gets a gentle taper without attenuating any landmark. Applied to every displayed delta (anchor and certified) in both runtimes, followed by edge_smooth_iterations rounds of rim-pinned Laplacian smoothing (rim re-clamped to zero every round) that diffuse the strain the taper concentrates inside its band -- no wrinkle ring at the ROI boundary, and the rim stays exactly frozen. All nine landmarks sit at taper weight >= 0.93. The certified-pipeline internals stay on the raw frozen meshes.

display_residual.note: The certified display adds the EDIT-RELATIVE projected residual resid(c) - resid(0) (removing the CVAE's edit-independent bias field), landmark-filled and Laplacian-smoothed with the above parameters; identical formula in both runtimes.
